m: īdṛśa, mf(ī)n. or īdṛśaka, mf(ikā)n. endowed with such qualities, such, ŚBr.; ChUp.; Mn.; R.; Bhag. : Śak. &c.; [with the final syllables dṛś and dṛśa of these words cf. the Gk. λικ in ὁμῆλιξ, λικο in τηλίκο-ς &c.; Goth. leika in hvêleiks, ‘which one’, svaleik-s, ‘such’; Mod. Germ. welcher, solcher; Slav. liko nom. lik, e.g. tolik, ‘such’; Lat. li in tâlis, quâlis.]
a: īdṛkṣa -śa a. (kṣī -śī f.), also īdṛś Such, of this kind, of this aspect, endowed with such qualities. — k n. Such a condition; such occasion.
